title: Fall 2025 MS/MPhil/MBA & PhD Admission Results (Phase 1) Announced
text:
📢 Fall 2025 Admission Results Announced

The results for
MS/MPhil/MBA and PhD programs
(Fall 2025, Phase 1) have been officially announced.
You can now view your result by clicking the link below:

🔗 View Your Result (https://exams.awkum.edu.pk)

Candidates who do not remember their
Form Number
can still access their results by selecting

"Fall 2025"
and entering their
CNIC number
on the result portal.
